content.short: Sound SDK is a TypeScript library for building DApps on the Sound Protocol.
content.description: Sound SDK provides practical tools and clear, step-by-step tutorials for using JavaScript and TypeScript to create musician-focused assets within the Sound Protocol. Developers can integrate the Sound API to pull data such as covers and music metadata into their preferred tech stacks. The SDK's scalability, together with the protocol, is supported through sponsorship on GitHub, enabling developers to build reliable integrations. It is designed to work across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Arbitrum, helping creators ship cross-chain assets efficiently.
